roles.brief: Several linked leaf-mass arrangements on real branches; near leaf detail, simpler middle crowns and matched distant silhouette.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: R1 lower trunk stays inside 0.343 m radius through 2.6 m, full crown above 4.2 m. Parent geometry/materials retained; no extra canopy roots.

roles.brief: Needle-cluster branches with a sparse lower tier and irregular upper spire; separate wind weighting and distant solid read.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Same published R1 body/crown fit and retained resource IDs; no new conifer placements.

roles.brief: Young bent stems and low bush clusters connect grass to tree scale; leave trunk access and routes open.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: B2 1.723 x 1.344 x 0.780 m source fits inside the original 0.944 x 0.810 x 0.924 m shrub envelope, with two crossed shrub forms and a lower fern or bramble sharing its root.

roles.brief: Broad asymmetric frond groups with sparse and lush variants; reuse approved ART-02 understory where suitable.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Sparse/lush fronds and lower grass share existing roots. Habitat envelope 0.889 x 0.439 x 0.883 m; regional envelope 1.592 x 0.810 x 1.579 m; ordinary ground cap is much smaller.

roles.brief: Mixed-height clumps and flattened edge variant, quiet olive/straw colour shifts; distribute in authored patches.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Meadow and flattened-edge source forms share the retained approximately 0.300 x 0.158 x 0.296 m mesh envelope, before the unchanged per-anchor scale.

roles.brief: Dense low wind-combed clump with a dry rim and green centre; fills pockets between rock without hiding ledges.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing regional dry_sedge geometry remains distinct. Small hillside tuft anchors receive the same bounded grass grouping. No new upland asset or occupancy.

roles.brief: Short rooted wet sedge hummocks, distinct from the finite harvestable reed_bed.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: The actual 1.335 x 0.809 x 1.104 m regional sedge and existing wet-ground reed anchors remain. They are not replaced by a grass mesh or a finite harvestable reed bed.

roles.brief: Thorny low scrub and coarse surviving grass, weathered seed heads, broken rhythm across grit rather than bare ash everywhere.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Two grass silhouettes fit the delivered 0.235 x 0.068 x 0.280 m dry-grass envelope. That height cannot support the selected substantial thorn scrub. Existing regional rules have no separate waste-shrub anchor.

roles.brief: Restrained thorn stems, leaf sprays and climbing ivy rooted to actual support; keep openings readable.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Bramble is the rooted low layer of shrub variant 1. The 3.316 m B2 climber requires its exact matching context deadfall; the retained 1.472 m short deadfall is a different support. No floating universal ivy is fitted.

roles.brief: Non-glowing shelf fungi, small mushrooms and damp wood debris as cosmetic habitat detail, no new harvest promise.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: No independent fungus source in the assigned B2/B4 candidate set or retained fungus anchor. Preserve the existing noncollectible deadwood; do not invent harvest silhouettes.

roles.brief: Damp moss cushions and dry pale lichen masks with different edge shapes; no universal carpet on every material.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.r7_status: retained moss; new surface sheets unsuitable
roles.assessment: Original regional moss stays. B2 lichen is a 2 mm sheet, while these anchors allow 0.7 m support rise; placing a flat sheet across them does not establish rooted contact. No arbitrary terrain-conformance system added.

roles.brief: Branch-correlated litter, dark humus and exposed soil transition; tiling maps plus a few silhouette-breaking chips.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: The 23 mm thick source patches require fitted terrain across about 0.95 m. Existing plant-root anchors do not supply that continuous surface fit or branch-correlated litter identity. Do not spread a floating carpet.

roles.brief: Attached flared roots crossing soil and rock; modular contact pieces derived from parent tree, no floating ends.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: R1 root burial and lower-body fit remain exact, as do original decorative arch feet. Adding a separate skirt would require a matching parent contact and envelope.

roles.brief: Broken log, stump and low branch variants; ordinary decorative pieces cannot mimic fresh resource yields.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Retain 1.472 x 0.312 x 0.411 m deadfall and 0.686 x 0.512 x 0.683 m stump. B2 supported climber cannot be attached to their different topology by uniform fit.

roles.brief: Irregular damp ledge, root shelf and reed-edge transitions, matching actual bank support and access.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: B4 river bank is part of its authored study landform. Existing generated water/pool boundaries are retained; no matching whole river-bank anchor or new geography is created.

roles.brief: Grouped angular scree plus rounded water pebbles; clustered with exposed ground between, not a collider on every stone.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing regional scree and ordinary chips already retain independent anchors and clearance. B2 supplies foliage, not a replacement pebble source.

roles.brief: Layered ledge transition and small outcrop variants; silhouette and material variation fit retained terrain.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing 4.050 x 1.696 x 2.478 m outcrop and native geology remain authoritative. Wider foliage is not fitted into rock-support roles.

roles.brief: Broken overhang/root lip and damp wall transitions framing existing cave opening; clear human entrance and host approach.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing C6 adapter remains installed; no relocated cave lip, new overhang or changed physical entrance.

roles.brief: Deep host-specific recessed channel with dark margins and contained moving light; ordinary/recessed-unlit/lit review states.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Retain approved host damage and moving light. All newly composed ordinary plant surfaces have altered=false and zero emission; source/work tells retain native meanings.

roles.brief: Reuse ART-04 Red host, owned fragments, recovered salt and charge language; native lot/formation states only.
roles.status: reuse approved family
roles.assessment: Existing body, finite lots, work and claim ledger retained; native paid Red extraction/restart is separately tested.

roles.brief: Reuse ART-04B White fractured host and recovered mineral; request transmission is not stored drive.
roles.status: reuse approved family
roles.assessment: Existing host, source lot and transmission identity retained. No cover anchor becomes a second source.

roles.brief: Reuse ART-04C layered host and recovered flakes; retain native formation and held-request distinction.
roles.status: reuse approved family
roles.assessment: Existing host/formation and held-request states retained; no new gameplay or cover replacement.

roles.brief: Reuse ART-04D root host and resin pieces; growth supports branching anatomy, not free item propagation.
roles.status: reuse approved family
roles.assessment: Existing root host, finite ownership and resin work state retained; ordinary shrub roots carry no propagation mechanic.

roles.brief: Braced split host with readable finite pressure reservoir and attachment; intact/worked/exhausted native stock, no spontaneous refill.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing visual/native source restoration remains synchronous; no new cover in its work/attachment space.

roles.brief: Weathered low masonry wall, broken corner and small rubble cap, root contact; no relocation or new wall collision.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: No changed wall poses, collision or generation; original C6 presentation remains under the existing adapter.

roles.brief: Fallen lintel, worn stair and fractured paving expose former human routes; keep existing entrance clear.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: No new lintel, stair or blocked doorway; native approach and body snapshots compare before/after.

roles.brief: Reuse original smithy language and LF marks/clamps; distinguish old ordinary craft from deliberate later containment.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Native paid workshop and controller route remain the evidence; new cover uses only retained envelopes and participates in original building clearing.

roles.brief: Exposed compacted soil, leaf-thin path edge and stone-step blend, no new pathfinding or forced navigation line.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: No continuous ground-sheet anchor exists along the full retained route. B4 layout and floor shader use its own study coordinates, which cannot be copied as new geography.

roles.brief: Readable shallow edge, slow broad flow and small local riffles; match existing water geometry, no new swimming/flooding.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Keep actual pool geometry/material/motion and boundaries. B4 authored river surface is not substituted into unrelated terrain.

roles.brief: Shared gentle direction with different branch/reed response; preserve leaf attachment and keep combat tells visually stronger.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Existing environment clock drives inherited 18 mm/m, 5.5 s B4 motion. Root-height subtraction fixes the base, and composed per-surface materials are no longer masked by the ordinary cover override.

roles.brief: Crown-group silhouette variants matched to near families; prevent a uniform green wall or obvious empty gaps beyond detail range.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Published R1 canopy plus original decorative skyline anchors. Visibility and selected LOD2 remain; near/middle/far views expose loss of small cover without inventing a distant forest.

roles.brief: Reuse actual terrain skyline, large rock value planes and restrained atmospheric separation; concept mountains do not replace geography.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Actual terrain, rock planes and inherited haze remain. Selected concept mountain mass is not authority to reshape the world.

roles.brief: Broken sunlight, readable cool shade and dusk warmth; local water/leaf events with quiet gaps, no continuous magic drone.
roles.status: proposed art brief; no new simulation identity
roles.assessment: Day/shade/dusk are matched inspection settings. No gameplay light rig, continuous audio, hidden source cue or new ambience rules.

scope: All 33 support-role briefs assessed. Empty observed cover counts mean a non-MultiMesh role or no such type in these four matched views, never an invented zero-world count. All regional anchor records are also retained in each raw report.
